profiles.name: Albert Hiromaru Matano
profiles.identity_verification: JCCH Sharp Park roster names Albert Hiromaru Matano March 1945. 1940 Waianae census index gives approximately 1927 birth. Family obituaries identify Albert as sibling of Alice, Jane, Betsy and Bernard; Tamako’s son in New York.
